### prerequisites (listed separately)
1. **-> optical_ext_frame_return_refund**, form `state`, kind state_gate. policy_source "The cancellation of an in-lab job is not confirmed until its frame charge carries the frame return refund." — verbatim in in_lab_eyewear_cancellation, "Conditions on the cancellation", 1st sentence; "not confirmed until" intact; in no other document. Resolution basis: frame_return_to_stock_refund "its frame return refund is booked as one refund credit against the frame charge" + records (frame charge 165.00, no credit). Strength: hard gate in both.
2. **-> optical_ext_option_cancellation_refund**, form `state`. "The lab retention is worked out only after each light-adaptive, blue-light filtering or anti-reflective option charge on the job carries its option cancellation refund." — verbatim, 2nd sentence; "only after" intact; only in the hub. Basis: lens_option_cancellation_refund "each light-adaptive, blue-light filtering or anti-reflective option charge of the job is refunded on its own, as one refund credit against that option charge" + records (photochromic 80.00, no credit).
3. **-> optical_ext_material_cancellation_refund**, form `state`. "The lab retention is not worked out before the material upgrade charge of the job carries its material cancellation refund." — verbatim, 3rd sentence; "not ... before" intact; only in the hub. Basis: lens_material_cancellation_refund "the lens material upgrade charge of the job is refunded as one refund credit against that charge" + records (material 45.00, no credit).
- The depended-on hubs do not carry these sentences and do not mention the confirmation; `condition`, `resolved_by`, `effect` appear nowhere.

## kb_to_source

- Every normative sentence traces to a source rule, variant parameter, lifecycle transition or tool contract. Derivations checked: "A vision plan frame allowance already credited against the frame charge is a different credit ... not a frame return refund" (follows from credit reasons); "Two different figures" in frame_restocking_deduction (restates the band-on-charge / percent-on-net split of the source compute); "Every lens design refunds a job cancelled before lab submission in full" (parameter).
- Added steps, confirmations, reviews, notifications, exception handling: none.
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none; each tool named only in its own hub.
- Opening world state written as fact: none; all examples hypothetical. Observation: some hypothetical lines are price-list combinations that coincide with this task's job (Premium + Trivex 45.00 -> refundable 15.00 in refundable_material_amount; 21-day window in lab_option_window_length); they are derived from the schedules and state no customer record.
- Omissions / rewrites: none at the level of entailment. Observation: the lab-day start default (order date) is entailed only by presupposition in lab_day_start, and the baseline-valued "otherwise" tiers are rendered as "outside this schedule/card" with the figure in the computation document — both consistent with how the source rule sentences are worded.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No KB-BIJECTION RED. First revision.

Policy-side note (not a KB verdict): several declared factors are nested — `frame_restocking_method` applies "the frame restocking percentage" set by `frame_restocking_percentage`; `option_refund_method` reads the window set by `option_window_length`; `lab_retention_percentage` reads lab days counted from the start set by `lab_day_start_anchor`. The factor documents therefore name a quantity defined in another factor document (frame_restocking_deduction, option_refund_by_option_type, lab_retention_percentage_by_lab_days). This is the source's own ladder wording; it names a quantity, not a document, tool or route.
